values.note: Trout Lake Township 2026 rates: non-electric sites $20 a night ($100/week, $320 for 28 nights), electric sites $30 ($150/week, $480 for 28 nights). Fees paid at check-in; every camper pays, even if doubled up. Read 2026-10-25.

fees.source: https://www.troutlaketownship.com/trout-lake-campground ('2026 Camping Rates ... Non-Electric Sites $20/night ... Electric Sites $30/night'), read 2026-10-25

hookups.source: https://www.troutlaketownship.com/trout-lake-campground ('we do NOT offer water or sewer at our campsites'; 'most of which have electricity', amperage not given), read 2026-10-25

sites.source: https://www.troutlaketownship.com/trout-lake-campground ('Trout Lake Township Park offers 90 campsites, most of which have electricity'), read 2026-10-25

facilities.source: https://www.troutlaketownship.com/trout-lake-campground ('The camping area has a shower house, water station, dump station, and public restrooms'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: The 2026 season opened Monday, May 18; no closing date is posted.

season.source: https://www.troutlaketownship.com/trout-lake-campground ('will open for the 2026 camping season on Monday, May 18, 2026'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Reservations by phone at (906) 569-3299, accepted from the first Monday in May (May 4 in 2026), and in person at the campground office once it opens; none before. A non-refundable 50% deposit is due no later than 30 days before arrival. Off-season questions: (906) 569-3291.

booking.source: https://www.troutlaketownship.com/trout-lake-campground ('New reservations for the 2026 season will be accepted starting Monday, May 4th, 2026 ... please call (906) 569-3299'; 'non-refundable deposit in an amount equal to 50% of the total cost'), read 2026-10-25

note: Trout Lake Township municipal park on Trout Lake, Chippewa County UP (mis-tagged 'Moran' on RV Life). Boat launch, swimming area; only a few sites directly on the lakefront. --Claude
summary: Read the township's own campground page. Changed fees $30-30 -> $20-30 (base is the $20 non-electric site; electric $30, 2026). Confirmed no water/sewer at sites, showers/dump, phone booking (906-569-3299, the entry's phone) with a 50% deposit; added 90 sites, potable water, 2026 opening May 18. Amperage, closing date and rig length not posted. Weekly/28-night rates exist but it sells nightly. Note trimmed of the fields' content and of the unsourced '60 with electric' (the page says 'most').
